About.title: About PhysioLink
About.intro: PhysioLink is a digital platform designed to make physical therapy follow-up simple, clear, and organized.
About.whatDesc: It helps physiotherapy specialists manage exercises and patients in one place, while allowing patients to easily view and follow their assigned exercises.
About.whoSpecialist: Physiotherapists who want a simple way to organize treatment plans
About.whoPatient: Patients who want clear guidance during their recovery journey
About.goalDesc: To improve communication, save time, and support better recovery through a simple and user-friendly experience.
